panels.title: Total alerts (range)
panels.description: All Falco events in the window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS "Total alerts"
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'falco' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'falco'
  AND JSONHas(Body, 'rule')

SELECT count() AS "CRITICAL+"
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'falco' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'falco'
  AND JSONHas(Body, 'rule')
  AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'priority') IN ('Critical','Emergency','Alert')

panels.title: HONEYPOT BREACHES
panels.description: Attacker escaped the honeypot emulation into the real container. Any non-zero = investigate NOW.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS "Breaches"
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'falco' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'falco'
  AND JSONHas(Body, 'rule')
  AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'rule') LIKE 'Honeypot Container Breach%'

panels.title: Distinct rules firing
panels.description: How many distinct Falco rules fired.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(JSONExtractString(Body, 'rule')) AS "Distinct rules"
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'falco' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'falco'
  AND JSONHas(Body, 'rule')

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(TimestampTime) AS time,
  JSONExtractString(Body, 'priority') AS priority,
  count() AS alerts
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'falco' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'falco'
  AND JSONHas(Body, 'rule')
GROUP BY time, priority
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  JSONExtractString(Body, 'rule') AS Rule,
  JSONExtractString(Body, 'priority') AS Priority,
  count() AS Events
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'falco' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'falco'
  AND JSONHas(Body, 'rule')
GROUP BY Rule, Priority
ORDER BY Events DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
  JSONExtractString(Body, 'output_fields', 'k8s.ns.name')  AS Namespace,
  JSONExtractString(Body, 'output_fields', 'k8s.pod.name') AS Pod,
  count() AS Events
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'falco' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'falco'
  AND JSONHas(Body, 'rule')
GROUP BY Namespace, Pod
ORDER BY Events DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Honeypot breach tripwire (Cowrie + Beelzebub) — should ALWAYS be empty
HONEYPOT BREACH events (any = someone escaped the emulation)
panels.description: Fires on unexpected process exec / sensitive-file read / container escape inside honeypot pods. See honeypot-breach.yaml.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  TimestampTime AS timestamp,
  JSONExtractString(Body, 'output') AS body,
  JSONExtractString(Body, 'priority') AS level
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'falco' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'falco'
  AND JSONHas(Body, 'rule')
  AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'rule') LIKE 'Honeypot Container Breach%'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  TimestampTime AS timestamp,
  JSONExtractString(Body, 'output') AS body,
  JSONExtractString(Body, 'priority') AS level
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'falco' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'falco'
  AND JSONHas(Body, 'rule')
  AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'priority') IN ('Critical','Emergency','Alert')
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Upstream ruleset changed (falcoctl auto-follow)
panels.description:
Falco's UPSTREAM ruleset is not pinned in git. A falcoctl-artifact-follow sidecar in every Falco pod polls ghcr.io/falcosecurity/rules/falco-rules:5 every 168h. ':5' is a FLOATING major tag, so any 5.x upstream publishes lands here and Falco hot-reloads it — no commit, no PR, no review.

This panel exists so that change is attributable rather than mysterious. If Falco suddenly starts paging Discord with a new false positive, or a detection you relied on goes quiet, LOOK HERE FIRST and check whether the ruleset moved on that date.

Empty is the normal state — it means the upstream ruleset has not changed in the window. falcoctl logs 'Nothing to do, artifact already up to date.' on every no-op check, including at pod start, so those are deliberately filtered out; only real changes appear.

Our OWN rules (honeypot-breach etc.) are NOT affected — they live in customRules in the Falco HelmRelease and are version-controlled. Only the upstream base ruleset moves.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  TimestampTime AS timestamp,
  Body AS body,
  'info' AS level
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'falco'
  AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'falcoctl-artifact-follow'
  AND (Body ILIKE '%Found new artifact version%' OR Body ILIKE '%Artifact correctly installed%')
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200
